notes.title: Make lags temporarily less
notes.notes:
I've been experimenting a bit with the quickest way to introduce something to make the lags less. This is just a temporary solution until I get the fixes done. Go to the options and select the popout menu. There you can adjust the quality of the graphics. Play the game on Borderless and choose a quality that works for you. I try to finish everything as quickly as possible. Thank you to all of you who criticise me, it helps me to work even faster on something. 
I have to program everything myself, fix things etc. so I'm always happy when the community reports bugs, lags or anything else directly.

notes.title: Lag and Bug Fixes
notes.notes: In this fix I've worked a bit on fixing the lags and some bugs. If you notice anything else please let me know so I can fix it.
